conflict_rule: Conflicting project policy sources require an explicit resolution before making a conformance claim. Do not infer legal jurisdiction from geography or UI type.

WCAG 2.1.remarks: 4.1.1 is retained in the historical criterion inventory but is considered always satisfied for HTML/XML in the updated recommendation. Avoid treating ordinary HTML parse errors as a proven accessibility failure.

WCAG 2.2.remarks: Nine additions relative to 2.1 and removal of 4.1.1 Parsing; requirements must be tested per chosen target and level.

WCAG 3.0.remarks: Research/advisory only. No 2.x conformance levels or compliance certification may be inferred from draft guidance.

reporting: Each WCAG 2.x audit must declare standard and level; all findings must be associated with that catalog. WCAG 3.0 notes are stored separately as non-normative draft observations.
